sources.quote: From Proto-Slavic *solь, from Proto-Indo-European *séh₂l-, *sḗh₂l. Cognates include Russian соль (solʹ), Polish sól, Sanskrit सलिल (salila), Ancient Greek ἅλς (háls), Armenian աղ (aġ), Latin sāl, and Old English sealt (English salt).
